label: AMENDMENT_SEX_STANDARDIZED
definition: A Amendment Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Proposes an amendment to the value of dwc:sex using the bdqval:sourceAuthority. It returns: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:sex is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:sex if it can be unambiguously matched to a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED. It uses the following default authority and/or parameter values: GBIF Sex Vocabulary. Its behavior can be altered by the following parameter(s): bdqval:sourceAuthority.
description: Proposes an amendment to the value of dwc:sex using the bdqval:sourceAuthority.
notes: For reference, a list of synonyms for dwc:sex values can be found at https://registry.gbif.org/vocabulary/Sex/concepts.
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:sex is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:sex if it can be unambiguously matched to a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "GBIF Sex Vocabulary" [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/Sex]} {"dwc:sex vocabulary API" [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/Sex/concepts]}
examples: [dwc:sex="f": Response.status=AMENDED, Response.result=dwc:sex="Female", Response.comment="dwc:sex found in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"],[dwc:sex="x": Response.status=NOT_AMENDED, Response.result="", Response.comment="dwc:sex not found in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"]
references: • GBIF (2015) Darwin Core Vocabulary: Sex GBIF Vocabulary. https://rs.gbif.org/vocabulary/gbif/sex.xml
